series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_qc_note: A split batch: five frames of Sothoryos jungle, all first-pass, then the caldera half where the architectural failure returned twice. 0431-0435 hold the humid register perfectly and 0435 lands the wyvern restrained to silhouettes. 0437 is the best dragon frame of the production so far and passes the four-limb check at 2x. 0436 and 0438 both render the caldera as a built cathedral - fluted columns with capitals, coursed ashlar, a rose window and a light beam - which is the exact failure logged at Batch 031 and is now a repeat offender.
sothoryos_note: SOTH-JUNGLE is new to the production and needs a bible entry: steaming plague-ridden jungle, wet black loam, grey limestone, buttress-rooted hardwoods, strangler vines, standing black water, steam haze, flat diffused light. NO golden light, NO sunbeams, NO sun disc, NO bright blue sky, NO turquoise water, NO beach, NO bright flowers, NO postcard tropics. Bone is black fossil, moss-taken, with roots grown through it. No faces, no maester.
caldera_reject_note: Both rejects share one cause: a prompt that says 'hexagonal basalt pillars rising to a lost ceiling' gets read as architecture. The fix is to describe the ROCK positively - hexagonal prisms broken at uneven heights, no capitals, no drum sections, no plinths, raw chaotic disorder, a ceiling of collapsed rubble and darkness - and to negate masonry courses, ashlar blocks, arches, vaults, rose windows, carved frieze and built symmetry by name. Batch 031 established this and it has now recurred.
letterbox_scan_note: Per-row content-box scan on all eight rendered. Five carried strips: 0431, 0432, 0433, 0434 and 0435 at rows 12-755, and 0437 at rows 40-727. 0436 and 0438 were full-bleed and were rejected on content, not framing.

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — Fossilized black dragon bones from icy Ib to Sothoryos
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 24mm steep up the trunk of a giant hardwood: a black fossil arc lying broken among the buttress roots, swallowed by moss and lichen, vines through the gaps, black water pooled in the hollows, canopy dissolving into steam-grey haze. No sun, no shaft, no colour in the sky. Establishes the Sothoryos answer without a single figure. Reframed rows 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — Fossilized black dragon bones from icy Ib to Sothoryos
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 85mm macro on the fractured cross-section of the fossil rib: concentric lamellae and radial fracture lines clearly visible, orange-brown lichen and green algae on the outer surface, roots through the crack, one dead leaf beaded with water. The frame that proves bone rather than a fallen log. Reframed rows 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail / expression beat — Fossilized black dragon bones from icy Ib to Sothoryos
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 85mm at head height where the bone has split along its length: the worn glassy inner curve filled with a mirror-still black pool holding a soft reflection of the canopy gloom, one wide leaf floating, thin grey mist low across the surface, background a soft wall of humid darkness. Nobody has been here. Reframed rows 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile / light study — Fossilized black dragon bones from icy Ib to Sothoryos
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1 with note. 100mm macro of a dull-crimson-seeded seedling standing in the bone socket, its narrow leaves veined red-brown, all beaded with condensation, black water and green algae below. Strong frame; the greens are a shade lusher than the Sothoryos lock intends, recorded as a palette note rather than re-rendered. Reframed rows 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide horizon / bridge framing — Fossilized black dragon bones from icy Ib to Sothoryos
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 40mm from the low bank: an opaque olive-brown river running out of frame to a vanishing point of grey-green vapour, jungle walls of buttress roots and hanging moss on both sides, and two WYVERNS circling high and distant as dark silhouettes only — membrane wings, whip tails, arrowhead skulls, no fire, no glow, no colour. Small in the frame and clearly animals, not heraldry. Reframed rows 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — Prehistoric sanctuary & the riddle of taming living fire
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 2. The anti-architecture brief worked: hexagonal basalt prisms of wildly uneven height with jagged snapped tops, toppled blocks, rubble and scree across the floor, gaps opening into black fissures, no ceiling, no capitals, no plinth, no vault, no symmetry anywhere. One narrow dull orange-red seam in a floor crack, thin grey smoke, faint cold grey above. The dragon mantles on a shattered prism, checked at 2x: exactly two taloned hind legs gripping and two wings, no third or fourth limb. Note: wings are spread rather than folded, which reads as mantling and is accepted. Reframed rows 12-755. Pass 1 was REJECTED as a built cathedral nave.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — Prehistoric sanctuary & the riddle of taming living fire
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 40mm over the shoulder of a cloaked Valyrian figure with a fall of long cool silver-white hair, hand raised, face never visible; beyond him a huge dragon lies on a vitrified shelf and watches. Anatomy checked at 2x: exactly four limbs — two taloned hind legs bearing the weight, two vast folded wings — no third or fourth leg, no arms; near-black plating, brass-gold slit eye, torn right membrane. Note: the horn cluster is heavier than the twin-horn lock, recorded rather than re-rendered. Reframed rows 40-727.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — Prehistoric sanctuary & the riddle of taming living fire
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 2. Wide view across the caldera floor: a jumbled forest of prisms at uneven heights with broken tops, toppled blocks in the rubble, a few flat plates of vitrified black glass among the scree, a small irregular aperture high above giving only dim cold grey. No masonry, no frieze, no shaft, no orange bloom. Three four-limbed dragons at different heights and distances, the nearest crouched with its head turned away. Pass 1 was REJECTED for coursed ashlar, a carved frieze and a glowing god-ray beam. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — Prehistoric sanctuary & the riddle of taming living fire
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 24mm from the caldera rim: the whole collapsed basin as a broken field of black rock and rubble cut by fissures, the far wall rising in shattered steps into cold mist, thin dark plumes bending one way, flat overcast above. Two dragons in flight, no larger than thumbnails, one low and one climbing toward the far rim. The widest statement of the dying-out line: a vast empty place with two animals left in it. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — Prehistoric sanctuary & the riddle of taming living fire
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. 50mm head and neck study in profile: near-black overlapping plates edged with faint dull bronze, twin swept-back obsidian horns lying flat along the skull, one brass-gold eye with a vertical slit open and calm, jaw closed, a fine crust of grey ash along the snout and horn ridges, one thread of thin grey smoke soft behind. The strongest dragon frame of the production and the best head study: watchful, entirely without malice, unreadable. Reframed rows 12-755.

caldera_fix_note: The anti-architecture brief worked on the first attempt. Describing the rock positively as hexagonal prisms of wildly uneven height with jagged snapped tops, toppled blocks, rubble and scree, gaps into black fissures and NO ceiling - plus naming masonry courses, ashlar, dressed stone, walls, arches, vaults, rose window, carved frieze, pilasters, capitals, plinths, symmetry, light shafts and god rays as forbidden - produced raw geology instead of a nave in both frames that had failed the same way.
